column3: Connect, declare, publish with a confirm, consume, acknowledge.
Redelivery is normal; an idempotent consumer makes it harmless.
A retry ladder that does not block the queue, dead letters, and replaying them.
A call over the broker with a correlation id, a reply queue and a timeout.
An append-only log you can read from any offset, and read again.
Publish and commit together, compensate a multi-step workflow, deliver later.
Metrics, health and traces, and reading them when something is wrong.
